questions.question: Evaluate pure metals and metal oxides / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Evaluate pure metals and metal oxides [E] / [CO4] Precious metals: Au, Ag, Pt, Pd recovered from e-waste by hydrometallurgy/electrometallurgy . Metal oxides (Cu ₂ O, Fe ₂ O ₃ , ZnO, etc.) are obtained via electrodeposition or oxidation. Both forms serve as valuable raw materials for nanomaterials and electronic components.
